title: Battle Cars Arena
description: Bolt sawblades, rockets, and turbo boosters onto custom battle rigs, then slam head-to-head against rival war machines in explosive arena duels.
controls: Drive, boost, and trigger mounted weapons to flip or wreck your opponent's battle vehicle.

zh-CN.title: 战斗汽车竞技场
zh-CN.description: 硬核改装对战战斗汽车竞技场：给战车焊上锯片火箭筒与装甲，开进竞技场正面硬刚撞翻所有对手！
zh-CN.controls: 控制战车冲撞走位并适时释放车载武器与加速，击毁对手战车赢得胜利。
